The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他一直都吃了” / Formula: Subject + 一直 + verb; or Subject + 一直 + 在 + verb / Correct: “他一直在尝各种植物。” “一直” describes an ongoing or habitual action, so do not use completed-action 了 here. Also, specify what he keeps eating/trying.

items.reason: “一直都吃了” wrongly uses completed-action 了 for an ongoing repeated action; “他一直在尝各种植物” is correct.
